anomalies.description: A white SUV collides with a cement mixer truck on a highway, resulting in visible damage and debris scattering across the road.
At an intersection, a dark SUV turns left and collides with a white SUV traveling straight; the impact causes the white SUV to spin and emit smoke/dust.

The windshield of the recording vehicle is struck and shatters violently, indicating a high-impact collision or projectile impact. The view becomes obscured by cracks and debris, with visible motion blur consistent with sudden deceleration or lateral force.

A white sedan enters the intersection from the right, appears to lose control or fail to yield, and collides with another vehicle (partially visible), resulting in a visible impact flash/spark and ejection of debris/dust. The white car rotates sharply post-impact.

A black sedan is stationary at an intersection with severe front-end damage; debris is scattered across the road, indicating a recent collision. Other vehicles are stopped nearby, suggesting the accident occurred just before or during this interval.

On a two-lane rural road, a dark sedan swerves sharply left and collides with a white car ahead in the same lane, causing the white car to spin and move toward the shoulder. The impact is visible between frames f8 and f10, with post-impact motion continuing through f11.
The vehicle from which the footage is recorded veers sharply right off the road, collides with trees, and the camera view becomes obscured by foliage and impact debris, indicating a crash.
Sudden violent impact causing extreme camera shake, whiteout flash, and loss of view—consistent with a high-speed collision or severe crash.

A sudden bright white flash fills the frame, consistent with an explosion or fireball, occurring immediately after the vehicle impact and likely resulting from fuel ignition or airbag deployment in extreme deformation.
Post-impact recovery phase: view reappears showing disoriented motion through foliage, likely vehicle spinning or veering off road after initial crash.

A black sedan abruptly cuts into the lane from the left and swerves sharply in front of the camera vehicle, creating an imminent collision risk; though no impact is visible in these frames, the maneuver constitutes a near-miss accident event.
A black sedan collides with a motorcycle at an intersection, causing the rider to be thrown onto the road and the motorcycle to fall. The car's front bumper is visibly damaged post-impact.
